claim: History, not a forecast. Money set aside for travel and kept in rolling 3-month T-bills roughly held its value in trips. For a trip that is half airfare, half lodging, waiting 10 years cost more (the money bought less of the same trip) in 52.2% of start months from Dec 1997 to Aug 2016, and the median 10-year wait still paid for 99.1% of the trip; the latest 10-year wait (Aug 2016 to Aug 2026) paid for 107.8%. Over 5-year waits, waiting cost more in 45.1% of starts. Airfares alone rose slowly (1.63% a year since late 1997, below T-bills' 2.15%): since 1963, waiting 10 years cost more in 43.2% of starts (median coverage 103.3%). Lodging rose faster (2.38% a year): waiting cost more in 65.2% of starts (median 96.6%).

T-bill growth over n months from month s: G = product over months s .. s+n-1 of (1 + TB3MS/1200), TB3MS = 3-month Treasury bill secondary market rate, percent, monthly average (pinned FRED CSV coed=2026-08-01). Price growth P: airfare A(s+n)/A(s); lodging L(s+n)/L(s); trip 0.5 x A(s+n)/A(s) + 0.5 x L(s+n)/L(s) (a trip whose cost is half airfare and half lodging at the start). Coverage C(s) = G/P: the share of the same trip that money set aside at s and kept in T-bills pays for at s+n. 'Waiting cost more' = C < 1. Start months: every month of the price series (both series for trip) with values at s and s+n.

assumptions: National price indexes for airline fares and for lodging away from home stand in for the cost of a retiree's trips; actual trips include other costs (cruises, tours, meals, car rental) not measured here.
A 'trip' is fixed at half airfare and half lodging at the start of each window; other mixes give results between the airfare and lodging figures.
The travel fund is kept in 3-month T-bills rolled monthly at the monthly average rate divided by 12 (discount-basis quote, not converted to an investment yield); taxes on interest are ignored.
Price indexes adjust for quality changes and are not seasonally adjusted; booking timing, peak seasons and loyalty discounts are outside the comparison.
